title: Fixed-choice step equivalence
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic oracle Turing machine, $O$ an oracle language, $b$ a choice bit, and $c$ a configuration. The step of $N$ using choice $b$ on $c$ relative to $O$ equals the step of the deterministic oracle machine obtained from $N$ by fixing its choice to $b$ on $c$ relative to $O$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of ordinary work tapes
A state type and symbol type
